close_reason:
Replaced bare Option<bool> 3rd-arg with Option<FileNodeGetParams> wrapper struct matching the mail-client EmailGetParams / metadata-client MetadataGetParams sibling pattern. Struct carries fetch_parents: Option<bool> (the current draft-13 §3.2.1 extension arg) plus #[serde(flatten)] extra: Map for vendor extensions. Re-exported at crate root.

Struct is NOT #[non_exhaustive] — matches the existing mail-client and metadata-client sibling templates (which also omit non_exhaustive on their *GetParams structs, since the workspace pattern is struct-literal construction for these specific Rust-API helper types). Future fields will be additive Option<T> fields, preserving backward compatibility through Default + struct-literal field assignment.

Workspace cargo test, clippy, rustdoc all clean. The crate's single client-side filenode_get test call updated to use the struct shape.
description:
**Files**: crate-jmap-filenode-client/src/methods.rs (file_node_get signature), crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs (email_get signature), crate-jmap-metadata-client/src/methods.rs (metadata_get signature)

**Divergence**: 3 of 8 extension-client \`<obj>_get\` methods accept an extension-specific third argument beyond \`(ids, properties)\`:
- mail-client \`email_get(ids, properties, params: Option<EmailGetParams>)\` — struct
- metadata-client \`metadata_get(ids, properties, params: Option<MetadataGetParams>)\` — struct
- filenode-client \`file_node_get(ids, properties, fetch_parents: Option<bool>)\` — bare primitive

**What goes wrong**: when the filenode draft inevitably adds a second \`/get\` extension argument (e.g. an analog of mail's bodyProperties/fetchTextBodyValues), the bare-primitive 3rd-arg shape forces a 4-arg signature, which is a breaking change. The struct shape (mail, metadata) grows by adding an \`Option<T>\` field — backward-compatible because callers pass \`None\` or a partial struct.

**Fix**: introduce \`FileNodeGetParams\` struct with one \`fetch_parents: Option<bool>\` field, then change the signature to \`Option<FileNodeGetParams>\`. The pattern is exactly the mail/metadata one. The crate is pre-1.0 so this is a small breaking change for filenode-client only.
title: filenode-client `file_node_get` 3rd-arg is bare `Option<bool>`; mail-client and metadata-client use `Option<XxxGetParams>` struct
